safety_verdicts.content: Patient normally uses the blue inhaler only as needed.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state that blue inhaler is normally used only as needed.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the reliever (blue) inhaler is normally used only as needed can misrepresent baseline asthma control and typical medication use, which may affect assessment of exacerbation severity and follow-up planning. However, it is unlikely on its own to directly cause significant harm.

Failure to document wheeze removes a clinically relevant symptom that can support the diagnosis and grading of an asthma exacerbation. Given other documented symptoms (shortness of breath/cough), the incremental harm is limited but could still impair clinical decision-making.
